mapper.select: SELECT 'PART:'||part_id FROM tb_bs_part UNION SELECT 'DEV:'||dev_id FROM tb_hr_dev UNION SELECT 'ASGN:'||asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn UNION SELECT 'PROJECT:'||proj_id FROM tb_pj_proj UNION SELECT 'PAY:'||#{month} UNION SELECT 'operating-standards:CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY 1
